name: Danger Light
author: Addicting Games
description: Danger Light is a free puzzle game. You must follow the pattern, you must remember the pattern, you must repeat the pattern. The pattern is how you will save yourself by avoiding obstacles and staying on track until you make it to the end of the level and collect your points. This is a game that requires deep concentration as well as a steadfast dedication to recognizing and following patterns. In this game, you will follow a set of blinking lights. In order to navigate your spaceship through an asteroid field and against enemy fighters. By repeating the pattern exactly as it was played for you, you will take control of the ship and avoid any incoming hostile threats. This is a game where attention to detail and pattern recognition is absolutely paramount to victory. You cannot win if you do not follow along or click when you're supposed to then you run the risk of failure and failure in this game can mean only one thing: defeat! Defeat means no top score on the leaderboard, it means no second chance, it means death. But don't worry this game is free, it is fun and you can play it over and over again until you get the knack of it.
